summary: itemgetter creates a callable that retrieves items using indexing.
documentation: itemgetter creates a callable that retrieves items using indexing. With multiple requested keys it returns a tuple, making it useful as a compound sorting key. Dictionaries and sequences can both be indexed.
inputs: One or more keys or indices.
returns: A callable yielding one item or a tuple of items.
caution: A missing dictionary key raises KeyError. Specify complete records and deterministic tie behavior for the intended sort.
scenarios: Sort job records by priority and a unique ticket number.
Order imported rows by several documented columns.
Extract a fixed combination of fields for comparison.
title: Order work tickets
problem: Input is a list of objects with integer priority and unique integer id, plus any extra fields. Return all objects sorted by priority ascending, then id ascending. Preserve every field.
goal: Use operator.itemgetter() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use itemgetter("priority", "id") as the key to sorted.
